title: Pre-check file access via access (c) — review required
description: The c call access checks a file before use. An attacker swaps the file between check and use. This lexical rule flags the check; the reviewer opens atomically via open with O_CREAT|O_EXCL plus fstat.
remediation: Open atomically with open with O_CREAT|O_EXCL plus fstat.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any access call matches.
